changelog: New voice command: say 'duplicate last character' or 'repeat last character' (or 'শেষ অক্ষর ডুপ্লিকেট করো' / 'শেষ অক্ষর আবার লিখো') alone while dictating and the last character is written again right after itself — handy for a doubled letter in a name or spelling, or a code digit, without re-dictating it. Undo removes just the copy, and the clipboard is never touched (75 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
